images.alt: A boy in a white shirt sits cross-legged on the carpet holding a grey Nintendo 64 controller, beside a wooden coffee table with a candle jar on it.
images.caption: A boy playing a Nintendo 64 at home, 1996
images.credit: Lisa Moody, 1996. CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

images.alt: Two black floppy disks with white labels reading DOOM, Shareware, Disk 1 of 2 and Disk 2 of 2, Created by id Software, 1993.
images.caption: The two floppy disks of Doom's free shareware version from 1993, which players copied and passed on to friends
images.credit: Pelle Wessman, 2008. CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons

images.alt: Two young people, seen from behind, sit at a beige Amiga 500 computer and monitor showing a two-player game, with a box of floppy disks beside it.
images.caption: Two players at a Commodore Amiga 500, the kind of home computer on which Andy Davidson wrote the first version of Worms, photographed in 2025
images.credit: App.211, 2025. CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

images.alt: A see-through yellow egg-shaped Tamagotchi with a small square screen, three white buttons and a silver ball chain.
images.caption: A yellow Tamagotchi made in 1997, in the collection of Museum Rotterdam, Netherlands. The museum links it to school bans
images.credit: Museum Rotterdam, object 78041. CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

images.alt: Seen from behind, a girl in a yellow T-shirt and pink skirt steps across a metal dance stage with arrow panels, beside a Dance Dance Revolution cabinet, with prize machines behind her.
images.caption: A girl dancing on the arrow panels of a Dance Dance Revolution machine in an arcade, 2011
images.credit: mliu92, 2011. CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons

images.alt: A beige tower computer and boxy monitor showing the Windows 3.1 Program Manager, with a keyboard and mouse, on a museum table next to a Microsoft information card.
images.caption: A 1990s PC running Windows 3.1, the version of Windows that first came with Minesweeper, at the Living Computer Museum, Seattle, USA, 2013
images.credit: Jason Scott, 2013. CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons

images.alt: A man and two children in jumpers stand by a street sign reading Pin Oak Ct on a quiet suburban street with gum trees, brick fences and a red car.
images.caption: Visitors at Pin Oak Court in Vermont South, Melbourne, the real street filmed as Ramsay Street in the TV soap Neighbours, 1996
images.credit: Gareth Williams, 1996. CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
